resources.string: Experimental: use charger power while battery charging is paused. The battery stays connected and may supply extra power under load. Turns off when unplugged or after a reboot. Other charging safety controls remain active.
Connect a charger to use this control.
Active: the charger power path is enabled and battery charging is paused.
Requested, but suspension is not verified. Another charging control may be active.
Charger controller error (%1$d). Switch off to release an existing request.
Unavailable: an updated kernel and access to its charging controls are required.
Status unavailable. Switch off to release the existing request.
Check the current status and try again. An unconfirmed request may still be enabled; switch it off to release it.
